resumeText:
Rohan Kulkarni | Bengaluru | rohan.kulkarni@example.com

EXPERIENCE
Physical Design Engineer, Kaveri Silicon Labs, Bengaluru (2021 - present)
- Own block-level floorplanning, placement, CTS and routing in Cadence Innovus for 7nm networking IP.
- Closed setup and hold timing across 12 corners using PrimeTime and ECO fixes.
- Analysed CMOS cell delays and clock skew while fixing critical timing paths.
- Debugged and fixed DRC and LVS violations in Calibre for three tape-outs.
- Wrote Tcl scripts to automate floorplan checks and timing report summaries.
- Run all flows on Linux compute farms with LSF job queues.
- Implemented power gating for two voltage domains using UPF.

SKILLS
Innovus, ICC2, PrimeTime, Calibre, Voltus, Tcl, Python, Linux

EDUCATION
BE Electronics and Communication, RV College of Engineering, 2021
